title: auth.user.created payload
description:
Payload for `auth.user.created`, published by Auth when an invitation creates a new account. Published at creation rather than at acceptance: that is where the rows are written, and the only point where an authenticated administrator gives the envelope its `org_id` (ADR-0002). Acceptance only flips statuses.

The file name is the routing key — that is how `SchemaDiscovery` keys the catalog, so renaming this file silently removes the contract.

user_id.description: Platform-wide user identity, as a string. Users are global; memberships are what scope them to an organisation (ADR-0016).

email.description: Normalised address the account was created for — lowercased and trimmed, as stored.

org_id.description: Organisation the invitation was issued in. Never null here: an account is always created into a tenant, so a consumer refusing a null (ADR-0018) never has to handle one on this event.
